verdict.rationale: Mastra is itself an official TypeScript framework/SDK. Developers build against it by importing its primitives (agents, tools) in code and embedding them in React, Next.js and Node.js apps, and community users report building directly on it. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript, a documented official client SDK for calling a deployed Mastra server, an API reference or OpenAPI spec (probes for OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Mastra is a framework for building AI-powered applications and agents with a modern TypeScript stack.
Add a tool to an agent by importing the tool and passing it to the agent constructor as a tools object.
Mastra bundles agents and workflows directly into existing React, Next.js and Node.js apps, or ships them as standalone endpoints.
